title: 1990 AMC 8 Problem 6
statement: Which of these five numbers is the largest?

solutions.text:
Choices A, B, and E are all very close to \(13579\), and choice C multiplies \(13579\) by a tiny number, making it much smaller.

Choice D divides by \(\dfrac{1}{2468}\), which is the same as multiplying by \(2468\). This makes it thousands of times larger than \(13579\), so it is the largest.

Thus, the correct answer is D .
hints: Dividing by \(\dfrac{1}{2468}\) is the same as multiplying by \(2468\)
All the other choices stay near \(13579\), but one of them becomes thousands of times larger
